theme_central: Oath by the pen and what is written: truth is permanent and recorded, and whoever carries it is of sound character — the entire thesis of the surah lies in its opening.
sources_note: 2-ruku structure precisely sourced (grokipedia): 1-9, parable of the garden owners 17-33.

branches.title: Oath by the pen
branches.resume: Oath by the pen and what is written, defense of the Prophet's integrity and sanity.

children.t: Oath by the pen, defense of the Prophet's integrity

branches.title: The contemptible man
branches.resume: Description of a contemptible man, habitual swearer, slanderer.

children.t: Description of a contemptible man, habitual swearer and slanderer

branches.title: The parable of the garden
branches.resume: Garden owners turned ungrateful after being blessed, plan to harvest at dawn without the poor, total destruction.

children.t: Ungrateful garden owners, total destruction as punishment

branches.title: Contrast: the pious / the criminals
branches.resume: The criminals cannot be treated like those submitted to Allah; what covenant would they have with Him?

children.t: Contrast between the pious and the criminals, no real covenant with Allah

branches.title: Yunus's patience, closing
branches.resume: Not to be like Yunus (Dhun-Nun) in his distress; the Qur'an, a Reminder for the entire universe.

children.t: Patience recommended like that of Yunus; closing, a Reminder for the universe
